reference: Contract expectations are taken from Bash's documented type/help builtin behavior and uv's published synopsis in docs/packages.md and loadables/uv.c. There is no matching GNU CLI for this loadable: it is a frontend to a separately packaged upstream uv executable, which is not available as an isolated fixture dependency here. No operation result is represented as GNU parity.
coverage: Bash reports uv as a builtin in the candidate.
Bash short help exposes the documented uv [UV-ARGS ...] synopsis.
Deferred: child argument, exported-environment, and exit-status forwarding with a deterministic local stand-in.
Deferred: helper resolution after changing directories following load-time resolution.
Deferred: documented missing-helper status and diagnostic with a controlled package tree.
Deferred: child signal handling and 128+N exit mapping in an isolated disposable VM.
Deferred: a bounded upstream uv project operation against an isolated local fixture/index.
exclusions: No network access or real package repository is used.
The runner cannot install a uv stand-in at the loadable's fixed compiled-in /usr/lib/bash-os/libexec/uv/uv path or provide a disposable package root for the separately packaged executable.
Package installation and environment creation are not GNU/POSIX command-line behaviors; operational cases remain deferred until an isolated upstream executable and local-only fixture are available.

cases.purpose: Check the Bash metadata contract that the optional uv loadable registers as a builtin.
Check the documented short Bash help synopsis for the uv builtin.
Exercise argument forwarding (including empty and spaced words), exported-variable visibility, and child exit-status propagation without contacting a package index.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable VM/package tree with a deterministic local stand-in installed at the documented uv helper path; the harness cannot supply that sibling executable. The future fixture should record argv and exported variables and return a chosen nonzero status, with no network access.

cases.purpose: Verify that a uv.so loaded from a relative package path keeps resolving its sibling helper after the shell changes its working directory.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable package root containing both uv.so and a local stand-in under the documented sibling libexec/uv path, loaded before changing directories. The harness cannot mount or populate the compiled-in package path.

cases.purpose: Check the documented status 127 and install hint when the separately packaged uv executable is missing.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable package layout in which the builtin is present but its helper is deliberately absent; the harness has no isolated package-root injection for this compiled-in loadable, and the host /usr tree is read-only.

cases.purpose: Check child signal defaults and the documented 128+N status mapping without signaling any host or unrelated process.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable VM with the sibling helper replaced by a reviewed stand-in that terminates only itself with a selected signal. No child signal behavior is exercised by this suite.

cases.purpose: Exercise a useful upstream uv operation against a tiny local project and verify its resulting fixture tree without network access.
cases.reason: Requires the pinned upstream uv executable in a disposable package tree and an isolated local project fixture. The helper is not supplied to the runner; if dependency resolution is included, it must use a local-only mock index. This has no matching GNU CLI oracle.
